lastCompletedStory.title: Add readPhaseBackend per-phase accessor in models.ts

nextStoryContext: US-002 (Repoint worker call sites to per-phase backend) should repoint the worker spawn call sites from readBackend() to readPhaseBackend(phase) one actor at a time. readPhaseBackend(phase, configPath?) is now exported from src/config/models.ts with the fallback chain: per-phase [backend].<phase> key -> existing global form (top-level backend scalar OR [backend].name) -> DEFAULTS.backend. readBackend() itself was left untouched (still used by run.ts's orchestrator logging call site) -- it is not being replaced, readPhaseBackend is additive. src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts (BackendAdapter interface, ClaudeAdapter.buildSpawnArgv) was NOT modified by US-001 per its own AC4; US-002 is presumably where that seam gets touched to actually consume the per-phase value.
